## Logs & Crash Reports

Please upload logs to:

https://mclo.gs

Required files:

### Client
- `logs/latest.log`
- `crash-reports/<latest crash report>.txt` (if present)

### Server
- `logs/latest.log`
- `crash-reports/<latest crash report>.txt` (if present)

Please do **not** paste massive logs directly into GitHub issues.
